subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Warehouse vs. Distribution Center
description: A 60-second lesson on Warehouse vs. Distribution Center.

hook.text: A warehouse stores things. A distribution center moves things through. Same building, different mission.

buildup.text: Warehouses prioritize storage capacity and long dwell times. Products may sit for weeks or months.

discovery.text: Distribution centers prioritize speed and throughput. Goods arrive and leave within hours or days.

twist.text: Many facilities blend both roles. The label matters less than understanding the actual flow of goods.

climax.text: Amazon's centers are DCs—goods move so fast that average dwell time is under two weeks.

punchline.text: Stores hold. DCs flow. Know which you need.

quiz.question: What does a distribution center prioritize?
